items: Each island now has a challenge area at the end of the footpaths: a stone circle with the island's glowing sigil and a ring of columns, guarded by an adult and a youth of every animal on the island
Win every one of them over (or see them off), then hold E in the circle to cast the music spell: the circle lights up on the beat, a little dancefloor rises and the animals party there
Clearing it gives you tonight's find, drawn from that island's own set; once you own the whole set you get a flask instead
Challenges are optional and close when the final wave is on its way
